about.title: About

I specialize in Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, and AI-powered backend systems using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and LangChain4j. I enjoy transforming complex engineering problems into high-performance, production-ready applications.

about.beyondDescription: Outside of software development, I enjoy exploring emerging AI technologies, reading engineering discussions on Reddit, experimenting with UI/UX design, and diving into science fiction, anime, and modern tech culture.

experience.description: Building Evalur, an AI-powered enterprise technical assessment platform that automates engineering readiness using Spring Boot, LangChain4j, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), secure code execution, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. Developing scalable backend services, JWT-based RBAC, PostgreSQL persistence, and a React 19 interface for AI-assisted assessments.
